title: Ñaawoore Ɓooygol
intro: Renndo, yiɗde ardaade ngam daranaade caɗeele mum en, ɗaɓɓiri yo komannda toɗɗaa e dow mum en. Nde ɗaɓɓaande maɓɓe jaabaa, cuɓaaɗo oo hawri e sikkitaare, sibu oo neɗɗo jogaaki darnde aduna nde ɓe cikkatnoo. Ko adii nde pottital ngal joofata, oo gardiiɗo keso ina foti ƴeewndaade diine konu nguu e jarribo reentaare, kono luggiɗngo.
clues: Mi toɗɗaama kumaandaŋ caggal nde leñol am ɗaɓɓi gardiiɗo ngam haɓaade e laawol Alla.
Heewɓe e leñol am e hoore am naamndiima toɗɗagol am e fuɗɗoode, ina ciftora ŋakkeende ngalu e leñol teddungol.
Mi suɓaama sabu Alla rokkii kam ganndal keewngal e darnde ɓanndu doole.
Maande laaɓnde e toɗɗagol am Alla ko gartugol Kees Alkawal, ngal maleykaaji njippini, ngal addani ɓerɗe gooŋɗinɓe jam.
Nde njahrat mi e soldateeɓe am, mi anndinii wonde maa min jarribee e maayo.
Mi yamiri konu am yo kala yarɗo haa juuti e maayo ngoo, wonaa e fedde am, ƴettuɓe tan ko ɓuuɓri wootiri e junngo mum en, keddotoo.

trial.label: Hol ko wonnoo ñaawoore am mawnde?
options: Mahde damal ngam haɓaade Gog e Magog
Haɓde e mawɗo e nder hare wootere
Wuurde e werlaade e nder yiite

location.label: Hol ko wonnoo maande mawnde e laamu am?
options: Koɗorɗe mail peewnaaɗe e njamndi softundi

outcome.label: Hol ko woni batte kampaañ am?
options: Feerndude maayo woɗeewo ngam daɗde e jom doole en
Sosde laamu juutngu e innde am

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
